about.title: About
about.geoip_attribution_after: and is used under the CC BY 4.0 licence.
about.intro: A self-hosted URL shortening service with an API and web interface. Anyone can shorten a URL anonymously (rate-limited); each created link gets a resource owner token for later management. Every link has a full click-analytics page, with anonymized IPs, so link owners can see traffic without exposing visitor identity.
about.who_individuals: Individuals and small teams wanting a self-hosted URL shortener
about.who_developers: Developers integrating link shortening via API + Bearer token
about.who_sharers: Anyone sharing links who wants basic click analytics without a full account system
about.feature_shortening_desc: generate a short code automatically, or choose a custom slug
about.feature_redirect_desc: resolving a short link 302-redirects to the destination URL
about.feature_analytics_desc: per-link click statistics: total clicks, referrers, a time series, and approximate location, with the visitor's IP anonymized before storage
about.feature_management_desc: update the destination, set or clear an expiration, or delete a link using the owner token issued when it was created
about.feature_no_accounts_desc: no signup, no password, no session; each link is its own resource, authorized by its own token
about.geoip_before: Approximate click-location data is provided by
about.geoip_after: Country and ASN data licensed CC BY 4.0 by the Number Resource Organization (NRO).

help.custom_slugs_intro: Request a specific short code instead of an auto-generated one:
help.slug_rules: Slugs must be 3-20 characters, letters/numbers/hyphens, and cannot collide with a reserved system name (for example api, server, static, about).

help.analytics_intro: Every link has a stats page — visit it in a browser, or fetch it as JSON:

help.api_docs_body: This application provides a full REST API. See the API reference for the complete endpoint list and request/response formats.
help.tor_intro: This application is available as a Tor hidden service for enhanced privacy.
help.faq_account_a: No. Anyone can create a short link anonymously; the response's owner_token is your only credential for managing that link.
help.faq_rate_a: Yes — anonymous link creation is rate-limited per IP address to prevent abuse.
help.faq_expired_a: A resolve request for an expired link returns 410 Gone instead of redirecting.
help.ts_404_a: The link doesn't exist, was deleted, or the slug was mistyped.
help.ts_410_a: The link existed but has expired.
help.ts_409_q: 409 Conflict when creating a custom slug
help.ts_409_a: That slug is already taken or is a reserved system name — choose another.
